                to flag an unusually high volume of same-day owner sign-ups.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already holds between 40 and 49
                owners (approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50),
                otherwise false. Used to flag a city that is nearing capacity;
                the hard rejection at 50 is unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner was created as a soft-match of an existing
                owner - it is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's
                lastName and postcode while having a different telephone -
                otherwise false. Assigned on creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title. When present it is one of
            'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR' and is used to compose the owner's
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR

          title: Address

            preferred and this value is returned as the composed address
            (normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized
            addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; normalized on create
            the same way as 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, when the owner's city maps to a known region
            (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), must fall within that
            region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when omitted on create it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag used on create. When true, the owner may be created
            even though another owner already has the same last name and postcode
            (i.e. they knowingly share a household); the owner is then created as a
            declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            When false or omitted, such a request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
            Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical link to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                where id is this owner's id. Derived on read.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed on read as the honorific
                'title' followed by a single space and the last name (e.g.
                'DR who'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for human reading as the
                country code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes. Derived on read; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone +
                lastName).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the
                (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year in which it starts.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted)
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is identified by the calendar year in which it starts,
                so YY is the last two digits of that starting year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the same
                household, computed as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same last name
                and postcode are therefore assigned the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the SHA-256 hex digest over
                (normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)).
                Duplicate detection keys off this single identity key: a create is
                rejected with 409 Conflict when another non-deleted owner already has
                the same identityKey, unless the request opts in with 'sharesHousehold'.
                Because the telephone is part of the key, two owners with the same last
                name and postcode but different telephones are not duplicates; they are
                created and flagged as a soft match instead.
              type: string
              example: '3b8e0f0d5a1c2b9e7f4a6d8c0e2f1a3b5c7d9e0f2a4b6c8d0e2f4a6b8c0d2e4f'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name
                (case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived on read. Starts at 0, gains
                2 when an email address is present, gains 1 when the name was unique
                on create (namesakeCount is 0), gains 2 for a household of 3 or more
                members, and gains 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds 1 elapsed fiscal
                year (fiscal years start on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived on read from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), taken from the REGION segment of the
                customerCode (the region derived from the postcode when the owner was
                created). 'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived on read from the locality
                (region) via the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW ->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD ->
                Australia/Brisbane. Absent when the region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read. 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived on read from 'birthDate' measured
                against 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18
                to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no 'birthDate' was
                supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                same day (registration date) as this owner, otherwise false. Used
                to flag an unusually high volume of same-day owner sign-ups.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already holds between 40 and 49
                owners (approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50),
                otherwise false. Used to flag a city that is nearing capacity;
                the hard rejection at 50 is unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner was created as a soft-match of an existing
                owner - it is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's
                lastName and postcode while having a different telephone -
                otherwise false. Assigned on creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone) when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false. DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags the owner true and retains the
                record, and the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks
                ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
